knowledge.plain_language_summary: A reconfigurable workstation sign: a CNC-milled 1/8in clear acrylic insert pocket held on a vertical tensioned-cable mount system with wall-mount and side-clamp hardware.
knowledge.rationale: A tensioned-cable insert rail lets workstation labels be reconfigured as the floorplan changes; the cable system is a composite mounting assembly outside the standard mounting enum.

structure.construction: CNC-milled 1/8in clear acrylic insert holder on vertical cable mount system, cable + wall-mount + side-clamp hardware

craft_observations: Modular tensioned-cable insert pocket = reconfigurable workstation ID.

proposed_new_terms.context: Vertical tensioned-cable mount system has no value in the mounting enum (ground/wall/ceiling/post).
